data_issues: Label noise: stim_class disagrees with the stimulus-log orientation_deg on ~28% of train and ~21% of val trials (stim_class is corrupted; orientation_deg is the true label, which decodes far better). Also, 5 units (indices 5,7,9,12,18) are silent (all zero counts) in the test set but active in train/val (dead units / channel dropout in test, covariate shift); the decoder was trained without them, which lowers achievable accuracy.
